evidence_limits: All UI motion comes from source 15. Only opaque privacy masks, native-scale crops, common padding, chapter titles and explanatory captions are added. No UI reconstruction, fabricated motion, inserted still image, or speed-up is used.

The source covers 147 minutes 18.05 seconds, but this is not 147 minutes of active testing. Raw seconds 1140–8500 (derived UTC 15:12:34–17:15:14) are 122 minutes 40 seconds of a nearly unchanged, unsubmitted file-name draft. The complete interval is retained in five explicitly labeled idle-archive videos. The highlight edit jumps across that gap.

The browser draft shows pricing.py in the file-name search, no chosen line and a disabled Start Debug Session button. It does not establish source retrieval, instrumented capture, completed source-case PASS, or a product defect. A nearly unchanged screen does not on its own prove an application hang.
The foreground provider briefly shows a 404 after dispatch, then shows the grouped workflow In progress. Neither status establishes a debugger capture or the ultimate workflow outcome.

Runner log samples show synthetic request counts and readiness booleans. They are diagnostic telemetry. The visible symbol_database_registered value changes across samples; no blanket registration-success conclusion follows.

The final recorded session inventory has My sessions ON and shows All 4, Active 0, Inactive 4. It is a filtered inventory. Later unfiltered inventory and child-disable checks are outside this recording and are not substituted into the footage.

Browser chrome, account and repository identifiers, service/session/profile identities, source URLs, token-bearing or private regions are cropped, opaque-masked, or omitted. Broad masks sometimes hide ordinary adjacent product text. Scrolling-log intervals whose crop is fully hidden are individually disclosed and provide no visible product evidence.

Every temporal omission is listed, including opening publication/repository administration, navigation/layout changes, and the browser-recovery new-tab/address-bar interval. These exclusions are not represented as successful tests.

The source declares nominal 20 fps but contains 176604 stored frames. It has 105 adjacent PTS gaps above 0.05 seconds, maximum 0.4 seconds. Constant-20-fps output holds existing recorded frames across those gaps. Source PTS and stored-frame ordinals are distinct from nominal 20-fps indices.
UTC labels are reconstructed from the recorder start. Provider timestamps, product event-row times, and recorder UTC are different evidence types.

Privacy review includes sampled OCR, dense transition and endpoint inspection, and structural comparison of every stored frame in the long unchanged interval at reduced resolution. This review is not a guarantee of every source pixel. All public videos decode and the raw source checksum remains unchanged.

Only the listed flat public folders are eligible for publication. Raw recordings, private review frames/OCR, scripts and working logs are excluded. This package preparation performs no external publication.

long_unchanged_interval_structural_check.limitation: All stored frames compared at reduced resolution. Structural stability supports sampling but is not proof of every source pixel or source retrieval.
